messages:
anya (PM): quick sync: we need the autofallback UX to be debuggable for operators and safe by default. thoughts?
liam (Eng): runtime can flip routing, but we should always emit a compact event with route, from, to, trigger, and window stats. that feeds the console and audit.
neha (SRE): triggers should be composite: e.g., sustained p95 latency > threshold AND 5xx spike OR validation-failures. single noisy signals are dangerous.
ravi (Design): display a one-line verdict in the dashboard like 'Auto-fallback: /v1/chat → m-small (latency)'. expandable details: sparkline, cause tag, impacted customers.
kira (Infra): API needs an escape hatch: POST /rollouts/{audit_id}/override with reason + dry_run boolean. it must write an auditable entry and optionally simulate.
liam (Eng): control plane decision: create a read-only audit rollout object at flip time that operators can promote with a suggested patch. avoids surprises.
neha (SRE): paging rules: page on persistent fallback (>15m) for enterprise plans or on error-budget breach. otherwise slack + console banner suffice.
ravi (Design): sample failures are useful, but auto-redact PII. show up to 3 samples, one per minute, scrub common keys.
kira (Infra): include model_checksum, kernel_variant, rollout_revision in the audit so we can exactly reproduce. also rate-limit autofallback events to 1 per route / 10m to avoid log floods.
liam (Eng): runtime event prototype: "autofallback" with fields: route, from_model, to_model, trigger, window_s, p95, five_xx_pct. control-plane enriches with route config.
neha (SRE): require hysteresis: once autofallback fires, block autoreturn for N minutes and require stable metrics before switching back. prevents flip-flop.
anya (PM): UX actions: "Inspect", "Open replay", "Force revert (dry_run)", and a link to SRE runbook. ensure the banner copy is actionable.
ravi (Design): timeline view: marker for trigger, switch moment, sample snapshots, operator actions. small legend for cause tags (latency|error|validation).
liam (Eng): edge case: validation-failure spikes often coincide with input distribution drift. if possible attach a prompt-distribution fingerprint hash to the audit.
neha (SRE): keep fallback_rate_by_route metric and 60d trace retention for high-compliance customers. also add a guard that suppresses repeated autofallbacks for the same route under a single incident.
kira (Infra): I'll add the override endpoint prototype and dry_run handling. it will emit an audit entry like "operator_override" with reason.
anya (PM): ok action items: liam to spec event v2 + rate-limit; neha to draft pager/runbook and hysteresis values; ravi to mock the compact card and timeline; kira to add API stub. i'll update the RFC.
liam (Eng): will post schema gdoc and sample queries.
neha (SRE): will share runbook to #eng-oncall and propose thresholds.
ravi (Design): mockups by Thu EOD.
kira (Infra): PR for override endpoint next week.
anya (PM): thanks all. call out missing cases here.
liam (Eng): one more: when autofallback flips to a quantized/cheaper variant, run a quick smoke-quality check against a small prompt set and attach results to the audit.
neha (SRE): good idea. also cap how many audits with samples we keep for privacy.
audit-bot: recorded 'autofallback_sync' for 1701239876
